{{InfoboxTabber |Staff|{{Infobox weapon | title = Staff of the Wild | image = Staff of the Wild.png |id = StaffGreenRoots | description = Ancient natural forces lie curled and dormant within this staff, ready to be unleashed. | type = Elemental magic | source = [[Galdr Table]] | crafting level = 2 | repair level = 2 | materials 1 = * [[Ashwood]] x15 * [[Fiddlehead]] x10 * [[Celestial Feather]] x3 * [[Jade]] x1 | materials 2 = * [[Ashwood]] x5 * [[Fiddlehead]] x2 * [[Celestial Feather]] x3 * [[Jade]] x1 | materials 3 = * [[Ashwood]] x10 * [[Fiddlehead]] x4 * [[Celestial Feather]] x6 * [[Jade]] x2 | materials 4 = * [[Ashwood]] x20 * [[Fiddlehead]] x8 * [[Celestial Feather]] x12 * [[Jade]] x4 |weight = 0.3 |blunt = 20 |blunt per level = 20 |poison = 20 |poison per level = 20 |eitr = 55 |durability = 200 |usage = Magic weapon |wielding = Two-handed |parry bonus = 2 |movement speed=-5% |adrenaline = 3 |block armor=48}} |Root|{{infobox creature | title = Summoned Root | image 0star = Summoned Root.png | id = staff_greenroots_tentaroot | faction = Player | health 0star = 250 | damage 0star = * 70 Blunt, 40 poison, 20 Chop, 20 Pickaxe (40 knockback, 4x backstab) | abilities = 10% chance to [[Immobilized|immobilize]] enemy for 10 seconds | resistant = Fire | immune = Poison, Chop, Pickaxe, Stagger }} }} '''Staff of the Wild''' is a [[magic]] weapon that summons '''Root'''. Each summon cast green projectile that causes blunt and poison damage on impact, and a thorny vine grows immediately from the area of impact. This gives two sources of damage from one cast: the initial projectile damage, and the lingering blunt/poison damage of the vine's attacks. Roots cannot move and automatically attack all enemies within range. Up to 10 roots can be spawned at once and they last up to 25 seconds. ==Root== '''Summoned roots''' are invoked by the [[Staff of the Wild]] and stay between 23 and 25 seconds before disappearing. They remain stationary and attack any enemy creatures within range. Their attack has a 10% chance to [[Immobilized|immobilize]] enemies for 10 seconds.
